Off Calendar Jul-15-2026 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES: Prior to Open Court, Atty. John Larson appears in the courtroom. The Court did not receive any notice to contest and there is no appearance by the other side. At ths instruction of the ocurt, the matter is not called. The Court's tentative ruling is the final ruling of the Court.

No appearances in Open Court. The Court adopts the tentative ruling as follows:

DEFENDANT ADEBOWALE SODIPO's DEMURRER to COMPLAINT.

Defendant Adebowale Sodipo's demurrer to all four causes of action in the complaint filed by plaintiff Laron Hodges is sustained as to all four causes of action with leave granted to Hodges to file a first amended complaint no later than August 7, 2026. While it appears that counsel for Hodges believes that a first amended complaint can remediate the claimed deficiencies in the complaint, if the failure to file a first amended complaint persists after August 7 Sodipo may seek dismissal of all claims against him.

Order is signed.

Visiting Judge: Harold E. Kahn, Clerk: M. Goodman, Not Reported. (302/HEK)
